FN-ARZJGS7-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 83
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/20/2026
Senate Bill 83 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Law
Institute to prepare or approve a training program in conjunction with the Alabama Probate
Judges Association for guardian ad litems pursuant to the provisions of this bill. This bill would
not otherwise directly affect state or local funding.
Page 1
